q: Bring 6 Elixirs of Lion's Strength and 2 Elixirs of Minor Defense to Syral Bladeleaf in Dolanaar.
Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.
Bring 6 Mudsnout Blossoms to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants you to bring him the hand of Dextren Ward.
Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.
Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear.
Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Chef Jessen in Southshore.
Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.
Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.
Retrieve 8 Tumbled Crystals and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.
Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.
Find Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar and get the Venomtail Antidote. Then bring the antidote to Rhinag near the northwestern border of Durotar.
Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.
Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
Slay 10 Crushridge Warmongers, then return to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
Bring 10 Webwood Venom Sacs to Gilshalan Windwalker at Aldrassil.
Protect Volcor until you reach the road, then speak to Terenthis in Auberdine.
Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon Sap, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.
Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
Return to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
Wait for Jordan Stilwell to finish forging a weapon for you.
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Bring forty Mithril Bars and four Citrines to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.
Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.
Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.
Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.
Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.
Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Recover the Silver Dawning's Lockbox and the Mist Veil's Lockbox for Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine. Both items should be found aboard the wreckage of the ships to the north of the village.
Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.
Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.
Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.
Return the book to its rightful owners.
Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
Return the Elementals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Mantle
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Aegis. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Travel to Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands and use Uther's Tribute at his statue, and then return to Wagner Hammerstrike outside Ironforge before the Harvest Festival is over.
Paragons of Power: The Demoniac's Robes
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
Obtain the Twilight Battle Orders and bring them Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

Contact Cenarion Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora and return the Hive'Zora Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
Summon and slay a Hoary Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
Summon and slay an Earthen Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.
Summon and slay a Crimson Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.
Summon and slay an Azure Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

Contact Cenarion Scout Landion inside Hive'Regal and return the Hive'Regal Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.

Contact Cenarion Scout Jalia inside Hive'Ashi and return the Hive'Ashi Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
Slay Twilight Marauder Morna and 5 Twilight Marauders. Report to Windcaller Proudhorn when your task is finished. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.

Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Azure Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
Give Mokvar your Coif of Elements and Vest of Elements.
Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Gauntlets if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gauntlets, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.

Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Leggings if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Leggings, 20 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.
